newsitem.title: TURKEY: Iraqi Kurd leader Talabani to hold talks in U.S..
newsitem.headline: Iraqi Kurd leader Talabani to hold talks in U.S..

text.p: Iraqi Kurdish leader Jalal Talabani is to arrive in Washington this weekend for talks with the U.S. administration, officials of Talabani's Patriotic Union of Kurdistan said on Friday.
"Talabani has been invited to Washington for talks by the Clinton administration," Shazab Saib, the PUK's Ankara spokesman, told Reuters.
Other party officials said Talabani arrived in London from his headquarters in northern Iraq on Thursday and would travel to the United States on Saturday.
It was not known how long the visit would last, the officials said.
The PUK is one of the two main Kurdish groups that have held power in northern Iraq since the area gained autonomy from Baghdad after the 1991 Gulf War.
A shaky ceasefire has held between the PUK and its main regional rival, Massoud Barzani's Kurdistan Democratic Party, since the two sides ended months of fighting last summer.
